admissionInfo.note: Application for admission to the graduate program with application fee by the established deadline.
admissionInfo.text: Application for admission to the graduate program with application fee by the established deadline. Submit official transcripts from all universities attended. A bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited college/university or the international equivalent. A 3.0 cumulative undergraduate GPA or a 3.0 GPA calculated on the last 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) of undergraduate work. Completion of Introduction to Algorithms and Data Structures (CS 2420 or the equivalent). For international students whose native language is not English, submit official TOEFL or IELTS band scores. A TOEFL score of 80 iBT (550 pBT) or higher, or an IELTS band score of 6.5 or higher within the past two years is required. International students must also meet all US government requirements for international students. The university uses a selective admissions process for admitting students to graduate programs. Meeting minimum admissions criteria does not guarantee admission to the graduate program or to the University as a graduate student. Recommended courses to take before the program begins are Linear Algebra (MAT 2270 or equivalent) and Statistics & Probability (STAT 2050 or equivalent).
